decisions.reason: As a web-map plugin that builds on the established offer and was given its own page, it fits the firm's direction and has enough visible commitment that management is likely to continue rather than reverse course so soon.

This search plugin is close to the core business, but because it was only mentioned on the website and seems comparatively modular, it is the easiest to withdraw if needed, though escalation of commitment still favors keeping it for now.
The mobile map layer control component is closely related to the firm's existing capabilities and its presence on the home page signals public commitment, which makes management inclined to persist.

A GIS platform with several models likely required substantial development investment and is central to the firm's announced path in integrated geospatial solutions, so management is very unlikely to drop it quickly.

Mobile field data capture software is a strong strategic fit with enterprise geospatial workflows and, having been presented on its own page, benefits from both investment and visible commitment that support continuation.

This search extension sits close to the established web-map business and was presented on its own page, so despite being easier to fold back than a full platform, management would likely keep it and attribute any weak early uptake to temporary factors.
